terms.meaning: A list of steps that shows how far a case has progressed.

sections.name: File setup, TimelinePage
sections.title: Timeline page and next-step link
sections.what: Draws the timeline for the case and a link that goes to the ready review packet, or to the next action page when no packet is ready.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond sending the user to the most useful next step.
sections.watch_out: The file is one long line, so changes to the link logic need care.

summary: Shows the case timeline and a link to the next step, either the review packet or the next action page.
purpose: Shows where the case is in its process and points the user to the next thing to do.
why: Reason not stated in the code. It appears to send the user to the review packet when one is ready.
how: Looks for a review packet with the ready-for-review status. If one exists, the link goes to that packet. Otherwise it goes to the next action page. The link label changes to match.
inputs: The review packets on the case and the chosen language.
outputs: A timeline page and one link.
risks: Only the first ready packet is used. The file is one long line in the packet.
debug: If the link goes to the wrong page, check the packet status value and the list of packets on the case. If the label is wrong, check the labels in the language file.
